The Arena

Built for the people who take it seriously.

Every station is tuned, cable-managed and ready. No queue roulette, no mystery latency — just sit down and play.

  • GPU GeForce RTX 40-series across the floor
  • Display 240Hz / 1ms competitive panels
  • Peripherals Hot-swap mice, keebs & headsets
  • Console bay PS5 & fight-stick stations
  • Network Low-ping wired LAN, dedicated lines
  • Lounge Snacks, cold brew & recovery seating
